Claude Code Remote Control: continue sessions from your phone with an always-on Mac mini

Reviewed: 2026-11-08 · wodeMac

Remote Control is an official Claude Code feature. Start it with claude remote-control, or type /remote-control (or /rc) inside a session, then open the same session at claude.ai/code or in the Claude app for iOS and Android. Code execution and file access stay on the original machine. It is available on Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise plans, not with API keys. The host has to stay online: when a laptop sleeps or drops off the network, Claude Code reconnects only after the machine comes back, which is why many people run it on a Mac mini that never sleeps.

What it is

Remote Control turns the web and mobile apps into a window onto a session running on your own machine. Your filesystem, MCP servers, tools and project configuration stay available; messages from terminal, browser and phone stay in sync; you can attach photos and files from your phone. Unlike cloud sessions, nothing runs on Anthropic's infrastructure. The official docs note that if your laptop sleeps or your network drops, Claude Code reconnects when the machine is back online, meaning the task waits in between.

How to start it

Server mode shows a URL and, with the spacebar, a QR code for your phone:

claude remote-control

Interactive mode keeps the terminal usable while the session is also reachable remotely:

claude --remote-control

Inside an existing session, optionally with a name:

/remote-control My project

The Claude Desktop app and the VS Code extension use the same /remote-control or /rc command. Then open claude.ai/code or the Code tab in the Claude app and pick the session by name.

Plans and sign-in

  • Available on Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise subscriptions; API keys are not supported.
  • On Team and Enterprise an Owner must enable Remote Control in the Claude Code admin settings.
  • Sign in first with claude and /login; without an eligible login, claude remote-control exits with an error.

Details follow the official Claude Code documentation and may change.

Why an always-on Mac

Remote Control solves "I am away from my desk", not "my laptop went to sleep". Put the session on a machine that is always online and both problems disappear: run claude remote-control in the project directory (inside tmux if you like) and pick it up from anywhere. A wodeMac dedicated M6 Mac mini stays online 24/7 in California with Claude Code preinstalled; sign in with your own Claude subscription. Usage limits, tool updates and task errors still stop an agent, so keep branches, logs and stop conditions.

FAQ

Which plans include Remote Control?

Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise, according to the official docs. API keys are not supported, and Team or Enterprise owners must enable it first.

Does the code run on my phone?

No. Execution and file access stay on the machine where Remote Control was started; the phone and browser are only the interface.

What happens when the host laptop sleeps?

The session disconnects and reconnects when the machine is back online; the task does not progress in between. To keep tasks running, host the session on an always-on machine such as a dedicated Mac mini.
